//: Accepted npm-audit advisories, consumed by scripts/npm-audit-gate.mjs. Every entry needs a reason and an expiry — an expired entry fails the gate again, forcing a re-decision instead of rotting silently. This matters more here than in a private repo: the SDKs generated from this contract are things insurers install, so an unreviewed advisory in our toolchain becomes their exposure too.
//scope: Every entry below is a transitive dependency of @stoplight/prism-cli, which is dev-only: it serves a mock of our own committed contract during development and in CI. It is not a dependency of anything published, it never runs in an insurer's or consumer's environment, and the only input it processes is dist/quoting/openapi.yaml — a file in this repository. prism-cli 5.16.0 fixed the advisories it could: its own lodash, fast-xml-parser and @faker-js/faker are all on patched versions. postman-collection 4.5.0 (pulled in by @stoplight/http-spec at ^4.1.3) exact-pins lodash 4.17.21, uuid 8.3.2 and @faker-js/faker 5.5.3, and postman-collection 5.x still pins faker and uuid. The `overrides` block in package.json lifts its lodash to ^4.18.1 and uuid to ^11.1.1 — both API-compatible for what it calls, and `npm run mock:check` passes on them — which leaves only the faker pin. postman-collection reaches us only through @stoplight/http-spec's Postman-to-OAS converter, a path prism never enters when mocking an OpenAPI document, and nothing in this repository imports it directly. Re-check at expiry: if Stoplight has not shipped, consider replacing the mock with a small hand-written stub server.

exceptions.reason: Arbitrary code execution when the template string expanded by faker's `fake` helper is attacker-controlled. Patched in 10.5.0, and prism-http 5.16.0 is on 10.6.0; the flagged copy is the @faker-js/faker 5.5.3 pinned by postman-collection, which only expands Postman `{{$random*}}` variables and is never handed one of ours. An override cannot fix it: forcing a patched 10.x makes postman-collection throw at load, because its dynamic-variable table calls v5 namespaces (`faker.address.city` among 118 others) that v10 removed. Renewed 2026-10-28 after re-checking: postman-collection 5.3.1 still pins faker 5.5.3 and @stoplight/http-spec 7.1.0 is still the latest.
